findings: Production and website staging both use the production Obelisk issuer. Website signup and signin intent currently both enter its signin screen.
Production provider health reports global signup=open with Turnstile=enforced and enrolment budget=open. Provider staging reports invite, but website staging does not use that issuer.

The production served signup switch preserves the authorization continuation; the resulting signup page renders signup and passkey enrollment actions for both website origins. Signup is not observed to be closed.
Global open policy plus a rendered signup form does not prove RP-specific open configuration, completed registration, successful website callback, confirmed membership creation or investor approval.
The direct Create Account intent currently reaches signin. A supported initial-signup-screen contract remains unverified; no parameter was guessed and no provider URL was rewritten in website code.

observations: Website RP enrollment override absent in local registry snapshot; the declared trust profile still says registration=closed. These local declarations do not establish deployed enrollment behavior.
Local authorize route hardcodes screen=signin; local app enrollment code supports explicit RP enrollment=open. Source snapshots alone are not deployment evidence.
